input.rationale: Section 4 achieves substantially the preferred position and is not redlined. Works (including deliverables, inventions, programs, documentation and data prepared for us under a SOW) vest in Clear Capital, with Contractor obliged to execute further documents and, on termination, expressly assigning all right, title and interest in Works in progress (p0033, p0044). Contractor retains only its own pre-existing tools, methodologies and know-how (p0020) — which the playbook expressly accepts — and grants us a royalty-free, perpetual, sublicensable licence to use, copy, modify and create derivatives of any Contractor's Information embedded in the Works for our business operations (p0021). There is no assignment or licence of Clear Capital IP or data to Contractor, and no joint ownership; our data supplied in the course of the Services is protected as Confidential Information (p0038). Minor sub-elements short of preferred, noted but not flagged: ownership vests as invoices are paid rather than on creation (consistent with the rule's "we own what we pay for" premise, and backstopped by the assignment of Works in progress on final payment); the licence-back is not styled "irrevocable" or "worldwide"; and there is no express standalone sentence confirming we retain all rights in Customer Data. These would be worth picking up in a future amendment or SOW but do not fail the fallback.
